# js-dos 8.4.1

This directory contains browser runtime files from the `js-dos` 8.4.1 npm
package.

- Project: https://github.com/caiiiycuk/js-dos
- Emulator backend: https://github.com/caiiiycuk/emulators

Only the files required by the Doom integration are included.
